name: STEICO SE
summary: STEICO SE develops, produces and markets natural construction products made of renewable raw materials in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Lichtenstein, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxemburg, western and southern European countries, and internationally. The company offers flexible and stable wood fiber insulation materials and panels; air-injected insulation made of wood fibre and cellulose flakes; construction products, such as I-joists and laminated veneer lumber products; wood fibre boards for industrial use; produces natural fibre boards; and services and supplementary system-related articles, such as plaster for composite thermal insulation systems.
